summary: A Facebook investment group promoted trading results and directed the user through a person called Keith to transfer funds from Kraken to Stonegate Options. The user later attempted to withdraw the funds from Stonegate Options but the withdrawal did not proceed.
user_mistake: transferred funds to a trading platform promoted by an online investment group
prevention: Confirm independent withdrawal history before transferring crypto to a promoted trading platform / Do not rely on group member profit claims when selecting a platform
